Ines Fujin crosses the finish line in<n>the autumn
Tenno Sho alongside the<n>dreams of many, with a
smile of pure<n>joy on her face.

Her doubts are gone. She's going to<n>keep enjoying
running for herself.<n>And I bet she'll turn all those
cheers<n>into her driving force.

For our next race, too, we should go<n>with the one
she'll enjoy most. We<n>decide on...

We decide to set the Japan Cup, a<n>race in which
runners from around<n>the world compete, as our
goal. It's<n>time for Ines and I to get our prep<n>work
started.
The Goal Race is now the Arima<n>Kinen.

The Arima Kinen, a race that draws<n>the attention of
many racing fans,<n>makes for a fitting goal. It's time
for<n>Ines and I to get our prep work<n>started.
